annotations.title: Create an alert rule that posts to a signed webhook

description: Creates an alert rule on the account that owns your API key (it also shows on the account's /alerts page, labelled "created by API key"). Needs an API key (x-api-key). Same kinds and validation as the site. Give the fields the kind needs (price_above/price_below: unit + priceAda; pct_move: unit + window + pct; volume_spike: unit + multiple; whale_trade: minAda (+ unit); wallet_activity: address; new_pool: unit or minLiquidityAda; nft_floor_above/below: policyId + floorAda; others: `paramsJson`). Deliver to a signed webhook with `webhookUrl` (public https only; the HMAC secret is returned ONCE, in `webhook.secret`) or to an existing `targetId`; with neither the alert stays in the account inbox. Deliveries are JSON POSTs signed with `X-Realtap-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<body>">` (verify it and refuse a t more than 5 minutes off your clock), retried with backoff. Rules per account are limited by plan, and a key may create 20 rules an hour. The result links the delivery log; use `test_alert` to try the webhook.

address.description: wallet_activity and wallet-based kinds: an addr1… or stake1… address.

cooldownSecs.description: Smallest time between two alerts of this rule (default depends on the kind).

floorAda.description: nft_floor_above / nft_floor_below: floor price level in ADA.

kind.description: What to watch. Use `paramsJson` for kinds that need fields not listed below.

label.description: A short name for the token / wallet / pool shown in the alert.

minAda.description: whale_trade: smallest single trade in ADA.

minLiquidityAda.description: new_pool: smallest liquidity in ADA (instead of, or with, `unit`).

multiple.description: volume_spike: last-hour volume as a multiple of the 24 h hourly average (at least 1.5).

paramsJson.description: Optional JSON object text with further parameters for the kind (merged with the fields above), e.g. {"types":["TreasuryWithdrawals"]} for gov_new_action.

pct.description: pct_move: the size of the move in percent.

policyId.description: NFT floor kinds: the collection policy id (56 hex).

poolId.description: Stake pool kinds: a pool1… id.

priceAda.description: price_above / price_below: the price level in ADA.

targetId.description: Deliver to an existing delivery target of the account instead (see `list_alerts`).

unit.description: Token unit: 56-hex policy id followed by the asset name in hex (no separator). Get it from `search` or `list_tokens`.

webhookLabel.description: Name for a new webhook target.

webhookUrl.description: Public https URL that receives the signed POST. Re-using a URL of the account re-uses its target (no new secret).

window.description: pct_move: the window the move is measured over.

name: create_alert
title: Create an alert rule that posts to a signed webhook
